name: Dhyaana Moolam Guru Murti
text:
ध्यानमूलं गुरोर्मूर्तिः पूजामूलं गुरोः पदम् ।
मन्त्रमूलं गुरोर्वाक्यं मोक्षमूलं गुरोः कृपा ॥
meaning: The root of meditation is the teacher’s form, the root of worship the teacher’s feet, the root of mantra the teacher’s words, and the root of liberation the teacher’s grace.
purpose: Reflection on the teacher as a source of meditation and learning.
